proof_body:
by
  intro S ι L M _ _ _ _ _ _ φ
  refine ⟨DirectSum.toModule S ι L φ, fun i x => DirectSum.toModule_lof S i x, ?_⟩
  intro ψ hψ
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro i
  ext x
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, hψ, DirectSum.toModule_lof]
target_source: ∀ (S ι L : Type*) (M : ι → Type*) [Ring S] [DecidableEq ι] [∀ i, AddCommGroup (M i)] [∀ i, Module S (M i)] [AddCommGroup L] [Module S L] (φ : ∀ i, M i →ₗ[S] L), ∃! ψ : DirectSum ι M →ₗ[S] L, ∀ (i : ι) (x : M i), ψ (DirectSum.lof S ι M i x) = φ i x
